name: session-recap
description: Recap any coding session (Codex, Claude Code, dsh, OpenCode): intent, key decisions, what changed, open threads and where to resume.

interface.shortDescription: Recap this or any earlier coding session
interface.longDescription: Reads saved sessions of Codex, Claude Code, dsh and OpenCode on this machine and writes a short recap: the intent, the key decisions and why, what changed, what is still open, and where to resume. Codex writes the recap with its own model; secrets in transcripts are removed first. Tools: list_sessions, recap_session, save_recap.
defaultPrompt: What was my last session in this project about?
